answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by forging identity through a slow ferrous chain of verified work instead of instant registration. Each identity anchors to a cipher-signed task trail reviewed by random peers outside its cluster. A comet of reputation builds only through sustained effort; failed audits burn the stake and sever the link. An honest agent tends one chain; clones must forge a constellation, paying the full cost for every fake key. Sybil floods become an unaffordable constellation.
